outcome: Number of uterotonic drugs administered during cesarean section
cohort: 51 adult women undergoing elective cesarean section under general anesthesia
finding: There was no significant difference in the use of intrapartum uterotonics between the remimazolam and propofol groups.
mod_finding: The study compares the use of remimazolam and propofol during cesarean sections and finds no significant difference in the need for uterotonic drugs between the two groups.
